items.title: Vucic announces he will soon resign as president
items.title_zh: 武契奇宣布即将辞去总统职务
items.summary: CLS, September 27 wire: Speaking in an interview with Radio Television of Serbia around noon local time on September 27, Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic said he will formally submit his resignation as president at around 8 pm local time on the 27th.
items.summary_zh: 【武契奇宣布即将辞去总统职务】当地时间9月27日中午，塞尔维亚总统武契奇在接受塞尔维亚广播电视台采访时表示，他将于当地时间27日晚8时左右正式提交辞呈，辞去总统职务

items.title: Giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang arrive in the United States

items.summary: CLS, September 27 wire: In the morning of the 27th Eastern Time, Chinese giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang arrived at Atlanta International Airport aboard a chartered flight.
items.summary_zh: 【大熊猫“平平”“福双”抵达美国】财联社9月27日电，美国东部时间27日晨，中国大熊猫“平平”“福双”搭乘包机抵达美国亚特兰大国际机场

items.title: CAICT's He Yang: China initially meets the conditions to study computing-power futures
items.title_zh: 中国信通院何阳：我国初步具备开展算力期货研究条件
items.summary: CLS, September 27 wire: He Yang, deputy director of the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology's Cloud Computing and Digital Research Institute, said that given the urgency — rapid AI development is driving sustained growth in computing-power demand and an ever-larger market — China urgently needs market-based pricing and risk-hedging mechanisms suited to it.
items.summary_zh: 【中国信通院何阳：我国初步具备开展算力期货研究条件】财联社9月27日电，中国信息通信研究院云计算与数字化研究所副所长何阳表示，从紧迫性看，人工智能快速发展带动算力需求持续增长，市场规模不断扩大，亟需建立与之相适应的市场化定价和风险对冲机制

items.title: At least 12 dead in a capsizing in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
items.title_zh: 刚果（金）东部沉船事故造成至少12人死亡
items.summary: CLS, September 27 wire: According to local Congolese media reports on the 27th, a boat accident on Lake Kivu in the east of the DRC has killed at least 12 people, with dozens more missing.
items.summary_zh: 【刚果（金）东部沉船事故造成至少12人死亡】财联社9月27日电，据刚果（金）当地媒体27日报道，该国东部基伍湖水域发生一起沉船事故，已造成至少12人死亡，另有数十人失踪

items.title: Cross-regional passenger flows reach 199.46 million trips on September 26
items.title_zh: 9月26日全社会跨区域人员流动量19946.2万人次
items.summary: CLS, September 27 wire: Per the Ministry of Transport, cross-regional passenger flows totaled 199.462 million trips on September 26 (the second day of the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday), down 17.6% from the previous day and up 3.4% from the same period of 2024.
items.summary_zh: 【9月26日全社会跨区域人员流动量19946.2万人次】财联社9月27日电，据交通运输部，9月26日（中秋假期第2日），全社会跨区域人员流动量19946.2万人次，环比下降17.6%，比2024年同期增长3.4%

items.title: Russian FM: the US and Iran should return to the Islamabad memorandum
items.title_zh: 俄外长：美伊应回归伊斯兰堡谅解备忘录
items.summary: CLS, September 27 wire: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said on September 26 that the US and Iran previously reached the Islamabad memorandum of understanding — a fair agreement signed by officials at the highest level of both sides — and the two parties should consider returning to it.

items.title: 'Funflation' is on the rise as hobbies get pricier, but consumers keep spending anyway
items.title_zh: “玩乐通胀”抬头：爱好越来越烧钱，消费者却照花不误
items.summary: Consumers are spending more on hobbies like arts and crafts and outdoor sports, as it gets more expensive to travel due to increased airfare.
items.summary_zh: 消费者在手工艺、户外运动等爱好上的开销有增无减，而机票价格上涨也令旅行成本愈发高昂。

items.title: Holiday news roundup: China and the US reach an eight-point consensus
items.title_zh: 假期要闻汇总：中美达成八点成果共识
items.summary: Key market-moving items over the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday: China and the US reached an eight-point consensus of outcomes; the Foreign Ministry spokesperson took questions on artificial intelligence; the US Treasury secretary said the two countries had agreed to extend the trade truce to January next year, with the Foreign Ministry responding; the central bank said it will comprehensively apply and timely adjust monetary-policy tools to keep liquidity ample; US media reported Trump rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days; and the US ITC formally launched action on dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) devices and their downstream products and components.
items.summary_zh: 中秋节假期影响市场的重要资讯有：中美达成八点成果共识；外交部发言人就 人工智能 问题答记者问；美财长称中美已同意将贸易休战协议延长至明年1月，外交部回应；央行称 综合 运用并适时调整货币政策工具，保持流动性充裕；美媒称特朗普拒绝伊朗七日内重开霍尔木兹海峡提议；美国ITC正式对动态随机存取存储器设备及其下游产品和组件启动

items.title: 'Thought it was phone bills — turns out it was loan repayments': China Mobile, China Telecom and China Unicom suspend 'zero-yuan phone' offers across the board
items.title_zh: “以为交的是话费，实际上是在还贷款” 中国移动、中国电信、中国联通全面暂停“0元购机”
items.summary: Per CCTV News, at the three carriers' offline service halls many consumers have encountered promotions such as 'get a free phone' and 'sign up for broadband, receive gifts.'
items.summary_zh: 据央视新闻，在三大运营商线下营业厅，不少消费者都碰到过“免费领手机”“办宽带送礼品”的宣传

items.title: A glimmer of peace gives way to fresh clouds: Trump rejects the 'seven-day deal' as Iran's president revisits the trust question
items.title_zh: 和平曙光乍现又生阴云 特朗普拒绝“七天协议” 伊朗总统再谈信任问题
items.summary: Just as Western markets were lifted on Friday by Iran's proactive 'seven-day Strait of Hormuz reopening' proposal, the odds of that proposal quickly translating into a market positive have clouded over.
items.summary_zh: 就在欧美市场周五为伊朗主动提出“七天重启霍尔木兹海峡”提案受到提振后，这份提案快速转化为市场利好的可能性迅速蒙上阴霾
